task.question: Who is the head chef at Chez Rose?
task.evidence: The day-to-day cooking is in the hands of head chef Mark Catchpole , whose CV takes in Roganic, Attica and The Fat Duck. The menu is a single sheet with a pretty logo, then a list of temptations: wild mushroom persillade with preserved truffle; Orkney scallop with Café de Paris butter; Cornish cod with mussel sauce and samphire; Aylesbury duck breast with black figs; and a T-bone steak for two at £145.
